slides.title: HOW GUN XP WORKS
rules: GUN IN HAND
Only the gun you use earns Weapon XP: Multiplayer, DMZ + Warzone.
1 LEVEL = 1 PART
Every weapon level unlocks a new attachment in Gunsmith.
MAX LEVEL
Differs per gun: the HAN 86 caps at 72, the Sang 9mm at 38.

slides.title: SHARED PARTS
rules: UNLOCK ONCE
Standard attachments unlock once and work on every compatible gun.
BONUS LEVELS
Already own a level's attachment? You get a free Bonus Level Up.
SMART ORDER
Level guns that share parts back to back to stack free levels.

slides.title: 2XP TOKENS
rules: RIGHT TOKEN
Use Double Weapon XP tokens. Normal 2XP only boosts your player level.
NO WASTE
Token timers only run during matches, never in menus or lobbies.
FREE TOKENS
The campaign gives you 2 Double Weapon XP tokens.

slides.title: BEST MODES
rules: OBJECTIVES
Hardpoint, Domination, Kill Confirmed: more score = more gun XP.
BOOSTED XP
Since 19 Nov: more Weapon XP in Wager Match + Ground War: Combat Outpost.
DMZ
Weapon XP counts in DMZ too. Keep your target gun in your hands.
